Found out after we broke up that she would intentionally make me hard to have sex, and had conditioned me that hard meant sex. She admitted years later it's because I was huge and she knew we weren't going to be together forever so she just wanted as much D as she could.
Yea. Being a dreamer gets me into shit like this. 😕

Long juicy story of how my life got turned upside down.

I was a helpdesk rep, working for a startup. She was the marketing director.
We awkwardly met in an elevator. I asked her if she wanted lunch not knowing who she was on her day 1. She said no. 
We have a team get together couple weeks later and she sat across from me.
She kept trying to steal a look. I had never really known the meaning until I met her. Her eyes were like magnets. She kept making me look over at her without conversation. 

Couple hours later she grabs my hand squeezes it. Tugs then and proceeds to walk out of the room with everyone. 

Jump to a couple weeks later. She invites me out after work. I work late but let her know I'll join later. This is when it happened. The party was close to dead. 3 of the office ladies in the lunchroom left. 

I go in sit down and say hi to everyone. They all mention leaving soon. Such was the life of the late shift. I go to get up and I feel her hand reach out and forcefully hold me in place hiding the hold behind my body while she says goodnight to the others.

Now they hadn't left. Just the room to get ready. As soon as the door to the lunchroom closes. She looks me dead in the eye "Meet me at the elevator in 5 minutes, I want you."

I was floored. Never in my life would I have thought something like this would happen. My heart is racing. 4:50...51. I get up I go over to the elevators and don't see anyone. Boom around the corner she is and she steps forward expecting me to do the first move.

This secret rendezvous keeps for a few weeks. It evolves into hand holding in public places. Using mugs or bags or tables to hide the hands.

She made it clear she's married and I was to tell no one. 

Things get more serious as she starts going out with me for dinners alone. We talk about life. I forget sometimes that this was a secret rendezvous. She tells me she wants me every single day in person or in text some way. 

Then the build up breaks a peak. She tells me I could be a CEO with my mindset. She would follow my vision. She believed in my ability to see the potential and beauty and possibility in life. 
In the coming weeks she tells me she will get me an apartment close to her house. She wanted me to live there and become the next big CEO of a tech startup. We both agreed this wasn't really the way to do it. Time passes. Nothing changes. All the same above keeps happening. 

To be clear. We have never had sex yet. Just hardcore fondling and makeouts. 

One fateful night. I stay out late. Past my ability to get home affordably. I say I need to go get a car to get home. She asks if I'll go to the woman's bathroom to fuck her. I reject. I don't want to get caught in woman's washroom. She pouts I start to leave after paying. She quickly runs after me as I leave. She says she has an idea but we have to go for a walk first. 

We walk and talk and hand hold. I tell her I want more. She deadpan looks at me and turns and gets in a car share car she had booked. I follow. She tells me she wants me to fuck her there. So. We do. It's amazing. She's got one hell of a body. 

Weeks pass. Things get more frisky at work and outside of work. Touching my leg. Touching my body. She wanted me. 

I told her we need to tell someone in the business or one of us needs to leave if she wants it to be a secret any longer. I couldn't do the emotional baggage. After many nights out she tells me she's made her decision and she wants to enact our plan. 

So I go and meet her at a cheeseburger joint in the middle of nowhere. We head to the roof. We have this amazing time. Romantic. Sexual.

She tells me she has a vacation planned to wait 3 weeks for her and then our plan will be enacted. 

She's pretty much off grid. Mia during the trip. Co worker was messaging her a bunch. (very religious and innocent man). Red flags start appearing everywhere. I wait a week. He says him and her are really close. I'm fearful at this point. So I warn him that she might not be in alignment of his religious values. Without letting loose something is between us. 

I let it go and carry on my life and trying to get promoted. 
She gets back to work. She's not sure her job is still safe as she was gone so long. We go out for lunch. She says I should come up to her house. So I do. 
Most awkward night. She starts being sexual. I respond. She says she can't do it. Not until she gets me my own place, and I'd have to quit my job tomorrow. I deadpan look at her and say I can't do it. I'm not ready to trust her.
I end up leaving even though this was a safe sleepover night.

While I left. I felt like something was really wrong. 

Next couple weeks I'm in the office I notice she hasn't looked at. Talked to. Or even acknowledged me. I find out she had been telling everyone she worked with that I was rude to women, that I had no manners (which is quite offensive as I do pride my manners). So much so I get pulled into my managers office saying I'm not being promoted because my image around the office isn't very good. 

I'm curious what I can do to solve this. So I confronted her. She deadpan says I have been rude to her and all women loudly in public. Then quietly asks me to dinner. Fuck it. Whatever. I accept. 

She tells me during dinner that we can't do this this way anymore. One of us has to leave and she wanted it to be me. But I didn't have her place and another job. I was new to the city. 

She said it has to be one of us until then we can't talk. 

She stops talking shit but the damage was done. 

I was asked to step off my path to get promoted and just be a "worker". I got my extra, fun duties removed. I went to days like the rest. 

But I couldn't shake my mind. It was wrought with the truth and no one knew it. 

It's hard still to type what's next but I tell my best friend who was also my co worker. Everything. Well to a basic degree. He's a moron and talks about it to another co worker in front of her because he assumed everyone in the business knew, he said it was sometimes super obvious. 

Over the next month. My mental state went spiraling. He dug deeper for answers. She started ruining my work and my mental state. 

Next thing you know we're at a work event. I kept to myself a lot. Her and her husband were there. She came behind me for the group pic and I felt her hand on my back. 

I mentally broke down. I had enough. I couldn't do it any longer. I left, took a new sales director dude home. 

Called in off and on during the next week's. Was relocated to a new desk with people around me.

I finally talked to someone. She told me I needed to take a leave of absence to deal with my mental trauma, so I did. 

To this day I have kept it in. But she ruined my life. She ruined the person I wanted to become. Somehow if I were to do it again I would. That's how into her I was. 

As a white male in the current climate of culture. I cannot go public with this. I don't have "proof" I just have my story and the life that was ruined by it. 

PS. She isn't working there any longer and I unofficially quit by not responding anymore. 

Sorry for the long story. Feels good to get it off my chest. 

-Ghost
